versions.content: Bit 4 of the NetworkStateCAN shall contain the Bus-Off state. This is a continuous state that is not related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item, and may also be reported in a data item where the FrameIDAvail- able and PayloadAvailable fields are set to 0 . The Bus-Off state shall be set to 1 when the CAN controller is in the Bus-Off state, and to 0 when it is in the Error-Active or Error-Passive state.
